_comment: HK50 qualitative overlay seed (v1, deterministic + free). Keyed by canonical HK ticker (native ADRs by their own symbol). policy_tier in {Tailwind, Favorable, Neutral, Headwind, Crackdown}; moat_tier reuses the AICT ladder {Fortress, Castle, Chapel, Stone, Wood} generalised to ALL sectors. These hand-curated tiers are the free baseline; an LLM deep-research run overrides them per-sub-metric (source flips curated -> hybrid/llm). EDIT ME — notes capture the dominant rationale as of 2026-Q2.

0700.HK.note: Tencent — post-crackdown thaw, gaming approvals normalised; WeChat social graph + gaming + cloud = widest moat.

9988.HK.note: Alibaba — antitrust fine paid, Ant restructured; e-commerce+cloud but PDD share pressure.

3690.HK.note: Meituan — gig-labor / commission scrutiny; local-services network effects, JD/Douyin incursion.

1024.HK.note: Kuaishou — content/algorithm regulation; short-video network effects but #2 to Douyin.

1810.HK.note: Xiaomi — EV + domestic-substitution beneficiary; smartphone+IoT scale, EV unproven.

9618.HK.note: JD.com — recovering; logistics scale but commoditised 1P retail, price war.

9999.HK.note: NetEase — consistent gaming approvals; durable evergreen IP + studios.

9626.HK.note: Bilibili — content regulation; Gen-Z community but thin monetisation/profitability.

TCOM.note: Trip.com — outbound-travel recovery tailwind; dominant China OTA network effects + supplier scale.

0992.HK.note: Lenovo — PC/server export-control exposure; #1 PC scale, thin margins.

1211.HK.note: BYD — EV/industrial-policy champion, subsidies; battery+vertical-integration scale.

0175.HK.note: Geely — EV support; scale but EV price-war margin pressure.

2015.HK.note: Li Auto — EV support; EREV niche eroding as rivals add range-extenders.

9868.HK.note: XPeng — EV support but loss-making; weakest moat in a brutal price war.

6862.HK.note: Haidilao — consumption support mild; hotpot brand, low switching cost / easy entry.

6690.HK.note: Haier — appliance trade-in subsidy beneficiary; global brand + scale.

2020.HK.note: Anta — sportswear brand portfolio (FILA, Amer/Arc'teryx), pricing power.

2331.HK.note: Li Ning — brand wobble, share loss, inventory issues.

0288.HK.note: WH Group — pork/food-security scale (Smithfield), but commodity cyclicality.

2313.HK.note: Shenzhou — US tariff / China+1 sourcing shift risk; sticky Nike/Adidas/Uniqlo OEM scale.

CHA.note: Chagee — fresh-tea brand, low entry barrier, hyper-competitive category.

EH.note: EHang — 'low-altitude economy' industrial-policy darling; eVTOL first-mover cert but unproven economics.

YUMC.note: Yum China — KFC/Pizza Hut scale + owned China supply chain, store density.

1801.HK.note: Innovent — VBP/NRDL price pressure offset by innovation-drug support; biosimilar+novel pipeline.

2269.HK.note: WuXi Bio — US BIOSECURE Act = active geopolitical crackdown (KEY FLAG); CDMO scale leader at risk of decoupling.

1093.HK.note: CSPC — heavy VBP exposure compressing legacy drugs; pivoting to innovation.

1177.HK.note: Sino Biopharm — VBP exposure on generics; scale + innovation transition.

0005.HK.note: HSBC — HK/UK dual; China-CRE exposure offset by global license + deposit franchise + buybacks.

2888.HK.note: StanChart — EM/trade-finance franchise; smaller, more cyclical.

1398.HK.note: ICBC — SOE 'national service' lending burden vs SOE-reform re-rating + ~6%+ dividend; largest deposit franchise.

0939.HK.note: CCB — as ICBC; SOE big-bank license oligopoly, high dividend, property-NPL overhang.

3988.HK.note: BoC — SOE big-bank, most international of the big-4; high dividend.

3968.HK.note: CMB — best-run retail/wealth bank, lighter national-service burden; sticky retail deposits.

0011.HK.note: Hang Seng Bank — HK retail franchise but China-CRE credit-cost overhang.

2388.HK.note: BOCHK — HK note-issuing bank + offshore-RMB clearing license moat.

2318.HK.note: Ping An — property + insurance-reform headwinds; scale + tech ecosystem.

2628.HK.note: China Life — SOE life insurer, rate-cut/spread pressure; scale + license.

1299.HK.note: AIA — pan-Asia premier agency franchise; HK/mainland-visitor policy tailwind.

0941.HK.note: China Mobile — SOE-reform re-rating + ~7% dividend + 5G/AI data-center policy; scale license oligopoly.

0762.HK.note: China Unicom — SOE reform; #3 telecom, license-protected.

0728.HK.note: China Telecom — SOE reform + cloud (e-Cloud) push; license oligopoly.

0883.HK.note: CNOOC — energy-security priority, low lifting cost, high dividend.

0857.HK.note: PetroChina — SOE integrated scale; downstream price-cap 'national service' risk.

0386.HK.note: Sinopec — refining/marketing scale; price-cap exposure caps returns.

1088.HK.note: Shenhua — coal/energy-security tailwind + high dividend; integrated coal-power-rail lowest cost (long-run decarb headwind).

0002.HK.note: CLP — HK Scheme-of-Control regulated returns; stable monopoly + dividend.

0006.HK.note: Power Assets — diversified regulated utility assets, net cash, reliable dividend.

0003.HK.note: HK&China Gas — HK gas monopoly + mainland city-gas concessions, regulated.

1109.HK.note: CR Land — property deleveraging headwind, but SOE survivor + investment-property recurring income.

0823.HK.note: Link REIT — dominant HK retail REIT; rate-sensitive, mainland expansion execution risk.
